_comment: Declared licenses for dependencies whose published metadata carries no SPDX-resolvable value, so an SBOM generator emits NOASSERTION. Each entry records the evidence it was derived from. Set "license": null to keep a package in the manual-review list.

pdf2docx.evidence: Core metadata License field: 'GPL v3'; bundled dist-info/LICENSE is the GNU GPL Version 3 text.

paddleocr.evidence: Core metadata License field: 'Apache License 2.0'; bundled LICENSE is the Apache 2.0 text (Copyright 2016 PaddlePaddle Authors).

bce-python-sdk.evidence: Core metadata License field: 'Apache License 2.0'. No license file shipped in the wheel.

visualdl.evidence: Core metadata License field: 'Apache License'. No license file shipped; version confirmed against the PaddlePaddle/VisualDL project, which is Apache-2.0.

ollama.evidence: No License field, but dist-info/licenses/LICENSE is the MIT text (Copyright (c) Ollama).

PyTaskbar.evidence: License field holds the full MIT text (Copyright (c) 2021 somePythonProgrammer) rather than an identifier.

pip-system-certs.evidence: Core metadata License field is just 'BSD'; bundled LICENSE has two redistribution clauses and no non-endorsement clause (Copyright (c) 2017, Andrew Leech).

cssselect2.evidence: Applies to the stale 0.2.1 copy on sys.path. Core metadata License field is just 'BSD'; bundled LICENSE carries the non-endorsement third clause.

imutils.evidence: UNRESOLVED. The 0.5.4 wheel ships no License field, no classifier and no license file. Upstream jrosebr1/imutils is MIT on GitHub but that is not asserted by the distributed artifact. Confirm with the author or vendor the license text before shipping.

pypdfium2.evidence: Core metadata License field: 'BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, dependency licenses'. Ships LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt, LICENSES/BSD-3-Clause.txt and LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt (docs only), plus the bundled PDFium build's own BUILD_LICENSES (pdfium BSD-3-Clause, freetype, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, libtiff, lcms, zlib, icu). All permissive; no copyleft in the set.

_annotations_comment: Packages where the auto-resolved SPDX id is technically correct but misleading. Printed as warnings by license_inventory.py.

annotations.pyinstaller: Resolves to GPL-2.0-only because the License field holds the full licence text, but upstream is GPL-2.0-or-later WITH a bootloader exception that explicitly permits bundling proprietary applications. The exception is what makes shipping runme.exe acceptable and should be recorded deliberately, not inferred.
annotations.pyinstaller-hooks-contrib: Same GPL-2.0-or-later with bundling exception as PyInstaller itself; the hooks are build-time only and are not linked into runme.exe.
